scenarios.given: A workload package omits executable expected behavior.
scenarios.when: The Specification Compiler evaluates readiness.
scenarios.expected: Reject with specification_not_ready before any product or Verification Asset write.

scenarios.given: A confirmed L1 path-normalization workload, current authority and sufficient budgets.
scenarios.when: The complete single-main-Agent vertical slice runs.
scenarios.expected: Publish one portable Candidate Bundle and work_package_completed without intermediate human checkpoints.

scenarios.given: A usable actual-only System Map view bound to the exact repository ref and commit.
scenarios.when: Initial scope, Context and verification closure are projected.
scenarios.expected: Downstream artifacts identify the consumed nodes and relations; the Map grants no authority.

scenarios.given: The relevant System Map area is unavailable or partial.
scenarios.when: An eligible L1 workload requires impact discovery.
scenarios.expected: Use bounded live-source fallback for only the affected area and continue without human input when impact becomes known.

scenarios.given: A large repository and 10000 unrelated dirty-file manifest records.
scenarios.when: The Context Curator builds the initial envelope.
scenarios.expected: Include bounded summaries and exact required selectors without copying the unrelated corpus into Agent Context.

scenarios.given: Duplicate and irrelevant Context Requests arrive repeatedly.
scenarios.when: The Context Curator evaluates grants.
scenarios.expected: Deduplicate unchanged content, deny irrelevant requests and charge each accepted content unit once.

scenarios.given: An Agent Result claims PASS, completion and touched paths.
scenarios.when: The Host-pull Agent Driver accepts the result.
scenarios.expected: Treat every claim as untrusted input and route the proposed delta through independent admission and verification.

scenarios.given: The user workspace contains an unrelated pre-existing dirty resource.
scenarios.when: A disposable Candidate is materialized and modified.
scenarios.expected: The original workspace remains untouched and the dirty resource is preserved byte-identically in the Candidate baseline.

scenarios.given: One proposed admission unit contains an allowed product change and a prohibited out-of-scope change.
scenarios.when: The Change Guard reconciles actual paths.
scenarios.expected: Reject the entire mixed admission unit, preserve its private delta for bounded rework and do not modify the user workspace.

scenarios.given: The actual PathNormalizer delta affects the read-only ManifestLoader.
scenarios.when: Actual impact is reconciled.
scenarios.expected: Add ManifestLoader regressions to verification closure without adding ManifestLoader to write scope.

scenarios.given: Passing required behavior truly requires changing ManifestLoader.
scenarios.when: The current write scope is reconciled with the required repair.
scenarios.expected: Stop the affected lane with scope_change_required and a structured revision proposal.

scenarios.given: A proposed Verification Asset deletes an assertion, widens an expected value, lowers a threshold, shrinks a fixture, removes a case or adds skip or xfail.
scenarios.when: The Test Auditor evaluates the proposal.
scenarios.expected: Reject the asset version without changing the fixed acceptance catalog.

scenarios.given: A Verification Asset implementation is defective while the expected behavior is unambiguous.
scenarios.when: A bounded repair is proposed.
scenarios.expected: Require independent re-admission and rerun the original scenario plus a known-bad probe before formal PASS.

scenarios.given: A normal required suite takes 60 seconds and has no reliable duration history.
scenarios.when: The Verification Runner applies the bootstrap timeout profile.
scenarios.expected: Do not terminate it at 30 seconds; use the 600-second unknown-duration hard deadline.

scenarios.given: A command exceeds its applicable hard deadline and leaves a child process.
scenarios.when: Timeout recovery executes.
scenarios.expected: Terminate the process tree, drain bounded output within the grace period and publish a typed timeout result.

scenarios.given: A verification command emits repeated tracebacks and shard failures.
scenarios.when: The Verification Runner captures diagnostics.
scenarios.expected: Keep the typed verdict independent and bound retained diagnostics by the approved byte ceiling.

scenarios.given: 10000 duplicate, late or out-of-order Agent Result references target old Candidate generations.
scenarios.when: Admission and completion consume results.
scenarios.expected: Ignore stale generations deterministically without contaminating the current immutable Candidate.

scenarios.given: The same inputs, Candidate, strategy and failure fingerprint recur without new evidence.
scenarios.when: Recovery routing evaluates another attempt.
scenarios.expected: Do not retry or spend additional Agent budget; publish one machine-actionable no_progress outcome.

scenarios.given: A transient runner workspace failure occurs before product verification starts.
scenarios.when: An approved equivalent safe recovery route remains.
scenarios.expected: Recreate the disposable runner environment and retry the same immutable Subject without asking a human.

scenarios.given: Equivalent path fixtures run on required Windows and Ubuntu profiles.
scenarios.when: The reference adapters normalize separators, Unicode and logical repository paths.
scenarios.expected: Produce the same Contract verdict while enforcing platform-specific absolute, UNC and junction or symlink boundaries.

scenarios.given: Relative, normalized, workspace-escape, absolute, UNC and junction or symlink path inputs.
scenarios.when: PathNormalizer is evaluated.
scenarios.expected: Return the specified canonical path or exact typed rejection for every input partition.

scenarios.given: One pytest asset and one non-pytest fixed-command asset.
scenarios.when: The Verification Runner compiles execution plans.
scenarios.expected: Use direct argv through typed adapters and never expose a generic shell executor.

scenarios.given: The current Specification, Candidate, admitted assets, impact closure and required results all match and pass.
scenarios.when: The Completion Judge evaluates the closure.
scenarios.expected: Publish only work_package_completed; higher-layer and external states remain not_evaluated.

scenarios.given: Work Package completion succeeds.
scenarios.when: Candidate handoff is exported.
scenarios.expected: Create a portable short-lived Bundle containing the manifest, patch, required blobs, admitted assets and typed result without applying it to the user workspace.
